वैवधिक वैवधिक, अस्, m. (fr. वि-वध),
a dealer, peddler, hawker, vender of various sub-
stances (as grain, oil, ghee, fruit, sweetmeats, &c.,
= विवधिक).

वैवर्ण्य वैवर्ण्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-वर्ण),
diversity of colour, change of colour or complexion;
deviation or secession from tribe or caste, &c.; hete-
rogeneousness, diversity, difference.

वैवर्त वैवर्त, अम्, n. (fr. वि-वर्त), revo-
lution, change or modification of existence; [cf.
ब्रह्म-वैवर्त.]

वैवस्वत वैवस्वत, अस्, m. (a patronymic
fr. विवस्वत्), N. of Yama as son of Vivasvat, (see
Yama); the seventh Manu or Manu of the present
period (as son of Vivasvat and brother of Yama);
the planet Saturn; one of the Rudras; (अम्), n.,
scil. अन्तर, epithet of the seventh or present Manv-
antara (as presided over by Manu Vaivasvata); (ई),
f. a patronymic of Yamī; the south, the southern
quarter.
—वैवस्वत-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a cele-
brated shrine and Tīrtha.
—वैवस्वत-मन्वन्-
तर, अम्, n., N. of the seventh or present Manv-
antara, q. v.

वैवाहिक वैवाहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-वाह),
belonging or relating to marriage, matrimonial, nup-
tial; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a marriage, wedding; (अस्),
m. a son's father-in-law or a daughter's father-in-law,
i. e. the father of a son's wife or of a daughter's
husband.
वैवाह्य, अस्, -ही, अम्, relating to marriage.

वैवृत्त वैवृत्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-वृत्ति), of
or belonging to Vi-vṛtti; (अस्), m. a particular modi-
fication of Vedic accent.
